points: Whisk yogurt, besan, coriander, paprika, turmeric, chili, salt + 2 cups water to a smooth batter
Pour into the tempering off a rolling boil, stirring constantly

points: Add the boiled gatte to the gravy; simmer 5 min to meld

cards.title: Keep the gatte soft
points: Yogurt and oil in the dough are what keep them tender, not hard
Add water gradually; a soft dough = a soft dumpling
Rest them in the hot water after boiling so they stay moist

cards.title: Balance the sourness
points: Yogurt gives the tang; a pinch of sugar rounds it out if too sharp
Coriander and paprika add depth that balances the acidity
Simmer gently after adding yogurt so it doesn't split or turn harsh

cards.title: Serving suggestions
points: Best with steamed rice or a warm bajra roti on the side
A spoon of ghee on top adds richness and softens the heat
Fresh coriander leaves make a nice garnish
